transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I came in because... well, I've been having this issue with eating. When I'm alone at night, once I start, it just feels like something takes over. I can't stop. Even when I'm literally telling myself in my head to put the food away, I just keep going.
During these episodes, do you eat an unusually large amount of food within a short period of time?

Yeah, I do. Especially on nights after I work a late shift. I'll eat... well, things like a whole frozen pizza, then cereal straight out of the box, whatever leftovers are in the fridge, and just any snacks I can find in the cabinet. It all happens within maybe an hour or two. It's definitely way more food than I'd ever eat in front of anyone else.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit?

Yeah, I do. After I eat like that, I usually end up in the bathroom making myself throw up. It just... it feels like the only way to undo it, you know? Like I have to get it out before the calories actually settle in.
How often do these binge-and-vomit episodes happen?

I'd say... for at least the last four months, it's been happening about once a week. There is usually at least one night each week where I'm alone, I end up eating way more than I ever meant to, and then I make myself throw up afterward.
